Full details: Title check

**Explanation** The title names the change: a bug fix in the Bedrock InvokeModel stream. It adds null stop_reason and stop_sequence to the message_start event, which matches the changeset. It is specific and under 100 characters.
Full details: Description check

**Explanation** The description follows the repository template. It has Summary, Changes, Type of change (Bug fix checked), Affected areas, How to test with commands and expected outcome, Breaking changes (No), and Related issues (Fixes `#9538`). It explains the problem, the fix, and the test. Some template items are missing: the Screenshots section is omitted (it applies only to UI changes), the Security considerations section is absent, and the Checklist is absent. The description does not say whether the docs or the CI checks were updated.
Full details: Linked Issues check

**Explanation** [`#9538`] requires `message_start.message` on `/bedrock/model/{id}/invoke-with-response-stream` to carry `stop_reason` and `stop_sequence` as JSON null. The whole-PR diff (merge base 447d244 to head d97361b) for `core/providers/bedrock/invoke.go` adds `"stop_reason": nil` and `"stop_sequence": nil` to the `msgStart` literal map in `toAnthropicInvokeStreamBytes`. Go encodes nil map values as JSON null, so both keys serialize as null. Existing keys are unchanged, and the `message_delta` branch is untouched, which matches the issue scope. The whole-PR diff of `core/providers/bedrock/invoke_test.go` adds `TestToAnthropicInvokeStreamBytes_MessageStartHasNullStopFields`. It unmarshals the first frame, requires the `message` object, and asserts each key is present and nil. The test was read at head in this review. It was not executed in this review. No coding requirement from [`#9538`] remains unmet.
Full details: Out of Scope Changes check

**Explanation** The whole-PR file set includes `core/providers/bedrock/invoke.go` (two nil-valued keys with a comment), `core/providers/bedrock/invoke_test.go` (one regression test), `core/changelog.md` (one Bedrock fix entry), and `tests/e2e/api/collections/provider-harness.json` (one e2e regression case for the same Bedrock route and fields). The code and unit test implement [`#9538`]. The changelog entry documents the same fix. The e2e case checks the same `message_start` fields on the same route, so it supports the objective. The `message_delta` branch and `message_start.usage` (the separate concern of [`#5885`]) are not changed. The e2e JSON contents were not read directly in this review. Its classification rests on the change summary, which describes the same route and fields. No unrelated change is identified.
